purpose: Prospectively test whether one rank-only expansion over the frozen v43 adaptive core can recover evidence only when concentrated role winners coexist with broad runner-up disagreement, on an untouched long-document biomedical evidence-retrieval validation set.

dataset_scope.evaluation_name: Evidence Inference 2.0 validation full-article sentence evidence selection
eligible_prompt: PMCID belongs to the registered validation article-id split and PromptID is unique
PromptID is absent from the frozen incorrect, questionable and somewhat-malformed lists published by the original repository and frozen BigBio loader
intervention, comparator and outcome are nonempty strings
the attached PMC plain-text article exists and yields at least five deterministic nonempty sentence candidates
at least one annotator group has accepted label and reasoning, a non-invalid label, a nonempty UserID and one or more finite nonnegative evidence spans
every retained inclusive evidence span maps by character overlap to at least one deterministic sentence candidate
dataset_scope.annotation_filter: Retain rows only when Valid Label and Valid Reasoning are truthy, Label is not 'invalid prompt', UserID is nonempty and Evidence Start/End are finite integers with 0 <= start <= end < article length.
dataset_scope.multi_reference_gold: Group retained annotation rows by PromptID and UserID. Union sentence ids from multiple evidence spans only within the same annotator group. Distinct annotators remain alternative gold references and are never unioned. Per-case precision, recall and F1 use the alternative reference with maximum F1 and the canonical reference tuple as deterministic tie-breaker.
dataset_scope.offset_rule: Evidence Start is inclusive and Evidence End is inclusive exactly as documented by the original repository; convert to the half-open interval [start, end + 1) before sentence overlap mapping.
dataset_scope.sampling_rule: Sort eligible validation PromptIDs by SHA-256 of 'FRC-EVIDENCE-INFERENCE-V49|' plus PromptID and then PromptID; select the first 600 without replacement. If 500 to 599 are eligible, use all. If fewer than 500 are eligible, stop before query generation.

blind_candidate_construction.sentence_units: Split the complete official PMC plain-text article with the registered regex boundary '(?:[.!?][\"\')\]]*|\n)\s+'; trim only leading/trailing whitespace while retaining character offsets; emit every nonempty span plus the final tail in article order.
blind_candidate_construction.canonical_id: sentence_<zero-padded ordinal> in deterministic article order
blind_candidate_construction.candidate_text: The whitespace-normalized sentence text with no prompt, annotation or evidence-derived augmentation.
blind_candidate_construction.pool: Every deterministic nonempty sentence from the complete attached article; no evidence-driven pruning, section filtering, training retrieval or first-stage truncation.
stored_blind_fields: opaque case id and PMCID commitment
candidate canonical id, normalized text and token cost
forbidden_blind_fields: UserID, label, classification or In Abstract
annotation text, Evidence Start, Evidence End or mapped evidence ids
gold reference ids, gold count, annotator count or evidence-location stratum
blind_candidate_construction.candidate_ceiling_registration: After sealed sampling and blind candidate construction, gold references may be used only to verify complete character-overlap coverage and freeze strata. No prompt, sample, candidate, method, formula or threshold may change afterward.
blind_candidate_construction.protective_behavior: Any invalid source hash, duplicate PromptID, missing article, malformed accepted span, incomplete retained reference, forbidden blind key, case-order mismatch or nondeterministic rerun stops before neural work.

frozen_models.score_calibration: per-case independent min-max inherited from v41

candidate_method_formula: Compute the unchanged four v41 dynamic atomic-role score columns for every candidate.
For each role, rank candidates by descending role score with canonical id as the only tie-breaker.
Let A be the union of the four role rank-1 ids and P be the union of the four role rank-1 and rank-2 ids.
Set expansion_triggered exactly when abs(A) <= 2 and runner_up_surplus >= 3.
Set target_cardinality = min(5, max(1, abs(A) + int(expansion_triggered))).

Select exactly up to target_cardinality candidates from the complete pool with the unchanged v41 dynamic rank-coverage greedy objective, frozen weight 0.5, canonical-id tie-breaking and the registered token budget.
The rule adds at most one reserve unit to the v43 argmax core and only when concentrated role winners coexist with at least three distinct non-core top-two proposals.
No score magnitude threshold, label, evidence, annotation, source position, candidate text class, dataset statistic or post-result rule may change A, P, the trigger, target or selection.

query_generation.input: Compared with <Comparator>, what effect did <Intervention> have on <Outcome>?
query_generation.fallback: frozen label-neutral templates plus the original question

evaluation.gold_join: After complete ordered query and score caches validate, attach alternative annotator-level sentence-id references and pre-neural strata to opaque cases.
evaluation.primary_metric: mean across budgets of maximum-reference evidence macro F1
evaluation.macro_precision: Mean per-case precision against the alternative reference maximizing case F1.
evaluation.macro_recall: Mean per-case recall against the same deterministically selected reference.
evaluation.macro_f1: Mean per-case maximum F1 over distinct annotator-level evidence references.
evaluation.complete_reference_recall: A case is complete when at least one alternative annotator reference is a subset of selected ids.
mandatory_strata: one versus multiple sentences in the smallest annotator reference
all accepted references marked In Abstract versus includes non-abstract evidence
unambiguous significantly increased versus no significant difference versus significantly decreased label
article candidate-count quartiles frozen before neural scoring
secondary_metrics: selected unit count and token cost
argmax-core size, runner-up-surplus and target distributions
selection-set difference rates versus v43, dynamic v41 and v46

decision_rules.gate_2: Always remains NO-GO/SHADOW in v49; one biomedical full-article validation result cannot authorize CANARY or DEFAULT.
decision_rules.publication: Publish favorable, null, negative or inconclusive results with source, protocol, implementation, cache and result hashes.
claims_forbidden: official ERASER or Evidence Inference leaderboard result

known_scope_limits: Evidence Inference supplies one attached full article per prompt rather than an open-corpus retrieval task.
Evidence spans are projected to deterministic sentence units and the registered splitter is not the original SciSpaCy pipeline.
Validation is used as a one-shot untouched confirmation set, not for tuning.
The endpoint is evidence selection, not comparative-treatment classification or clinical advice.
Biomedical evidence cannot replace district flood-domain expert evaluation.
